adjudication.rationale: The diff rewrites cancellation deletion to handle multiple calendar references by switching from `find` to `filter` and iterating (`handleCancelBooking.ts` around the new `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)` loop). In the recurring-bookings branch, the Promise set that iterates over all `_calendar` credentials and `updatedBookings` now sits inside that per-reference loop, so if there are multiple `_calendar` references it will execute redundantly once per reference. The diff also adds a prisma credential fallback (`prisma.credential.findUnique`) in this loop. No tests were added/updated in the diff to cover this new multi-reference cancellation behavior (the only test change shown is an unrelated webhook e2e expectation change from `null` to `[]`). The claim about “silently leaves calendar events behind” is more speculative (the rest of the cancellation flow/awaiting `apiDeletes` isn’t shown here), but the redundancy + lack of coverage for the new nontrivial logic is diff-grounded.
